behaviors.description: Require bundle verification using an explicitly selected public key.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unsigned A and signed B bundles, valid public key and installed runtime.
behaviors.expected: Explicit verification rejects unsigned A without deployment; omission permits that control, and the same key verifies and installs exact signed B.

mappings.rationale: A valid key distinguishes signed and unsigned independent bundle inputs, with exact deployment oracles.

surface_assertions.rationale: The explicit key requires a valid signature and permits only independently signed content.
